newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up five cents to 14.10 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up five cents to 14.10 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose five cents to close at 14.10 ringgit ($5.63) a kg, in reaction to Friday's rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good demand at the opening, mainly because of the LME," said a trader. The LME closed $25 up on Friday.
Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia.
Traders noted initial bids of 130 tonnes against offers of 73. Turnover was 90 tonnes from 108 previously. The local premium against the LME widened to $70 a tonne from $60.
